title: Unsupervised Clustering Algorithm Selection
description: Guidance on selecting clustering algorithms based on cluster geometry, noise tolerance, and scalability.
conditions: Unsupervised discovery of latent customer segments, patient phenotypes, or behavioral clusters
No ground truth target labels available
recommended_methods: K-Means clustering with K-Means++ initialization for spherical, equal-variance clusters
DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering) for arbitrary shapes and automatic outlier noise separation
Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering for taxonomy generation and dendrogram inspection
selection_rules: Determine K in K-Means using the Silhouette Score combined with the Elbow method on inertia
If dataset contains irregular spatial shapes or extreme noise, select DBSCAN over K-Means
If dataset N > 50,000, avoid Hierarchical clustering due to O(N^2) memory complexity; use MiniBatchKMeans
limitations: K-Means fails completely on non-convex or elongated cluster geometries
DBSCAN is sensitive to the choice of epsilon (eps) and struggles in datasets with varying density
